units.source_text: 太君见夕雾来了，不胜欢喜，又甚放心。

en.t: When the lady saw that Yugiri had come, she was overjoyed and felt greatly relieved.

units.source_text: 对他说道：“我活了这么大年纪，不曾遇见过如此狂暴的风呢！”

en.t: She said to him, "I have lived to this great age, but I have never encountered such a violent wind!"

units.source_text: 说时全身发抖。

en.t: As she spoke, her whole body trembled.

units.source_text: 此时但闻院中大树枝条被风吹折之声，非常可怕。

en.t: At that moment, all they could hear was the sound of great trees in the garden having their branches snapped by the wind, and it was terribly frightening.

units.source_text: 甚至有的房子瓦片全被吹散，一片不留。

en.t: Some houses even had all their roof tiles blown away, with not a single tile left.

units.source_text: 太君对夕雾说：“且喜在这狂风中，你平安地来到了我身边。”

en.t: The lady said to Yugiri, "How glad I am that, in this wild wind, you have come safely to my side."

units.source_text: 太君年轻时代，身边非常热闹，现在冷静了，全靠这个外孙来聊慰岑寂。

en.t: In the lady's youth, her household had been very lively, but now it had grown quiet, and she depended entirely on this grandson to ease her loneliness.

units.source_text: 真可谓人世无常！

en.t: It truly showed how impermanent human life is.

units.source_text: 其实她家现在并不衰败，只是内大臣对她的关怀，比前稍稍疏慢而已。

en.t: In truth, her household had not fallen into decline; it was only that the Minister of the Interior's concern for her had become slightly less attentive than before.

units.source_text: 夕雾听了一夜怒吼的风声，心中不由得感到凄凉。

en.t: After listening all night to the roaring wind, Yugiri could not help feeling desolate at heart.

units.source_text: 他一向恋恋不舍的那个人，现已退避一旁；

en.t: The person for whom he had always felt such lingering attachment had now withdrawn to the side;

units.source_text: 而昼间所窥见的那个人的面影，却一直使他不能忘怀。

en.t: but the image of the person he had glimpsed during the day kept him from forgetting her.

units.source_text: 他想：“这到底是什么用心？

en.t: He thought, "What intention can this possibly be?

units.source_text: 我难道起了不应有的念头么？

en.t: Could I have begun to harbor thoughts I ought not to have?

units.source_text: 真可怕啊！”

en.t: How dreadful!"

units.source_text: 他努力自制，把心移转到别的事情上去。

en.t: He struggled to restrain himself and tried to turn his mind to other matters.

units.source_text: 然而那面影又不知不觉地出现在心头。

en.t: Yet that image, before he knew it, appeared again in his heart.

units.source_text: 他又想：“这实在是个空前绝后的美人！

en.t: He thought again, "She truly is a beauty without equal before or since!

units.source_text: 父亲有了这如花美眷，为何又娶东院那个继母来与她并肩呢？

en.t: When Father already has such a flowerlike beloved, why did he also marry that stepmother from the East Mansion and set her beside this one?

units.source_text: 这继母全然比不上那继母，而且越发相形见绌，真倒霉啊！”

en.t: That stepmother cannot compare with this one at all, and by contrast she looks all the more inferior. What a misfortune!"

units.source_text: 由此可知源氏心地甚是厚道。

en.t: From this one can see that Genji's heart was deeply kind.

units.source_text: 原来夕雾为人很规矩，对紫姬决不存非礼之心。

en.t: Yugiri was, by nature, a very proper man, and he would never harbor any improper feelings toward Lady Murasaki.

units.source_text: 但他总是希望：可能的话，也娶一个这样的美人，和她朝夕相对，则有限的生命也可稍稍延长。

en.t: Still, he always wished that, if it were possible, he too might marry such a beauty and face her morning and evening, so that even his limited life might be lengthened a little.
